title: Translucent acorn-shaped craft over fisherman pulling up nets
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Translucent acorn-shaped craft over fisherman pulling up nets, about c. 2023 at Alto Nanay region, Amazon, Peru, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one guy said, the guy who drew on the acrylic chalkboard said that he was pulling up his nets at night. And as he was doing that, it was like he said like somebody turned the lights on or the sun suddenly came up and he looks up and 30, 40 feet above him is one of these craft

plain: A man named Tim Alberino, who went to the Alto Nanay region of the Amazon in Peru around 2023, told podcast host Jesse Michels what a local fisherman described to him, drawing it on a clear plastic chalkboard. According to Alberino, the man said he was pulling up his nets at night when suddenly it was as if someone turned the lights on or the sun came up, and he looked up to see a see-through, acorn-shaped craft 30 or 40 feet above him. If true, it would be a close sighting of an unknown craft by an ordinary local witness.
